elstyleSaver.innerContent:
High School Dual Enrollment Authorization
Completed by a school official for sponsored payments.

The school district approves the student for the dual enrollment option selected below and authorizes Oakland Community College to bill either:

  • The school district for public high school students
  • The State of Michigan for non-public high school students

Billing is authorized until the student’s maximum funding limit is reached.

Courses remain subject to high school counselor approval and seat availability.

Questions about billing or payments?
Contact ACCTSREC@oaklandcc.edu or 248.341.2263.
